Workplace Communication 

It's important to use the right kind of communication in the workplace. 

Different workplaces require different types of communication. 

For example, some workplaces require digital communication and physical communication. 

Tips for Effective Mind Maps: 

- Keep it simple – No sentences. Just phrases or words. 
    
- Be creative – Use different colors, shapes and images. Be purposeful. (each branch / cluster has one color) 
    
- Stay organized – Ensure branches are logically structure. Nodes should be relational. 
    
- Review and Revise – Mind maps should change and update over time. 
    

Use [https://app.mindmup.com](https://app.mindmup.com) for mind mapping in this case.
